description: Samba Bank Limited is a commercial bank operating in Pakistan and a subsidiary of Saudi National Bank of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, which holds 84.51% of its shares. It traces its roots to the Saudi banking group then known as Samba Financial Group, which acquired a majority stake in Crescent Commercial Bank in Pakistan in 2007 and rebranded it as Samba Bank; after Samba Financial Group merged with National Commercial Bank in 2021 the parent became Saudi National Bank, while the Samba brand continues in Pakistan. It operates as a full-service bank across consumer, corporate, investment banking and capital markets, is expanding into private banking, wealth management and transaction services, and runs both conventional and Islamic banking.
